# Read-back

A single session chair and AV technician are running a three-speaker conference session in one room that must finish by 10:30 AM coffee break. Each speaker gets a 30-minute talk followed by 5–10 minutes of questions (planned for 7 minutes each, with the third Q&A elastic at 10 minutes). The bottlenecks are a single projector (which cannot load a new deck while a talk is live), a single lapel microphone pack (which must be unclipped and re-clipped between speakers, taking 5 minutes each time), an AV desk, a lectern, and a foyer for catering. Before the room opens, the AV desk must be line-checked (30 min), the projector tested (15 min), and the lapel pack checked (10 min). Slide decks load sequentially: the first after the lapel pack is verified (10 min), the second during the first talk's questions (5 min), and the third while coffee is being served to the foyer (5 min). A coffee station sets up 90 minutes before start (30 min to set, then goes out to the foyer when the second Q&A ends, takes 20 min to distribute), and the foyer must be clear before the third speaker changeover (10 min clear). The AV desk strikes after the session closes (20 min). The chair opens with a 5-minute housekeeping and closes with a 5-minute wrap. The projector and lapel pack are the binding constraints—decks cannot load during talks, and changeovers cannot start until the pack is ready.
